context: Drive the public anonymizer and each relevant CSV/HTML/tuning export path with a corpus of nested dict/list/scalar shapes. Implement recursive handling only for identifier-bearing companion fields, preserving structural shape and non-identifier values. Sequence after the existing tuning item and after the platform metadata boundary item to avoid simultaneous edits in results anonymization tests. Do not turn this into a blanket string hash of all tuning content. The corrected rungs instantiate AnonymizationManager and place constraints under requested, matching the production tuning payload contract.
description: Complete tuning-constraint anonymization for untrusted companion shapes that remain reachable after #1479/#1486: constraints that are not dictionaries, lists of table/column dictionaries, local_table and references_table fields, and slash-delimited or mixed scalar collections. Current develop still leaks orders/o_orderkey and customers/c_custkey through these shapes even though the simple primary-key mapping is pseudonymized. Keep booleans, enabled flags, actions, and unrelated tuning values intact. This is the corrected successor of tuning-companion-constraint-shapes-v1; its stored rung was repaired during adversarial plan review.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not anonymize every string in the tuning payload.
anti_patterns.instead: Target identifier-bearing companion fields and assert preservation of representative non-identifiers.
anti_patterns.why: That would destroy analysis configuration and action labels.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not only add another top-level key to a deny-list.
anti_patterns.instead: Drive nested dict/list/scalar companion shapes through the public export chokepoints.
anti_patterns.why: The residual defect is shape variation and value materialisation, not one missing key.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not weaken the gate to the already-passing simple primary-key shape.
anti_patterns.instead: Keep the unfixed gate on list-of-dicts and mixed companion shapes.
anti_patterns.why: That was the exact blind spot exposed by the adversarial sweep.

preserves.behavior: Constraint enabled/action/boolean semantics and nested collection shape.
Non-identifier tuning configuration needed for downstream analysis.
Pseudonym stability for repeated identifiers across all export formats.

verifications.command: uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'import json; from benchbox.core.results.anonymization import AnonymizationManager; payload={"requested":{"constraints":{"foreign_keys":{"tables":[{"table":"orders","columns":["o_orderkey"],"referenced_table":"customers"]},"local_table":"orders/o_orderkey","references_table":"customers"}}}; out=json.dumps(AnonymizationManager().anonymize_tuning_payload(payload)); assert all(x not in out for x in ("orders","o_orderkey","customers")), out'
verifications.description: Unfixed-tree gate: nested table/column companion identifiers must not survive public anonymization; current develop leaks the orders and o_orderkey sentinels.
verifications.expected: FAIL on unfixed develop: companion identifiers survive nested tuning shapes; exits 1 before the shape-complete fix and 0 after it.

verifications.command: uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'from benchbox.core.results.anonymization import AnonymizationManager; p={"requested":{"constraints":{"primary_keys":{"enabled":True,"tables":{"orders":["o_orderkey"]}}}}}; o=AnonymizationManager().anonymize_tuning_payload(p); c=o["requested"]["constraints"]["primary_keys"]; table=next(iter(c["tables"])); assert c["enabled"] is True and table.startswith("table_") and c["tables"][table][0].startswith("column_")'
verifications.description: Regression guard: the already-supported simple mapping remains pseudonymized and boolean tuning semantics remain unchanged.
verifications.expected: PASS on current develop and after the change: existing anonymization and tuning semantics remain intact.

work_units.summary: Re-drive all remaining companion shapes on current develop and check related PRs.
Implement recursive companion-field anonymization while preserving structure and non-identifiers.
Add public/export-format regression tests and run targeted result checks.
